title: Finding Evidence Fast — PubMed, PEDro, Cochrane and a 15-Minute Routine

hook.en: There are millions of papers and you have fifteen minutes between patients. The trick is not to search harder, but to search in the right order, in the right places, with the right words.
hook.ur: Lakhon papers hain aur aap ke paas mareezon ke beech pandrah minute hain. Hunar yeh nahi ke zyada mehnat se search karein, balke sahi tarteeb mein, sahi jagah, sahi alfaaz ke saath search karein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll follow a 15-minute search routine, choose between PEDro, Cochrane and PubMed, build a Boolean search with AND, OR and MeSH terms, and save what you found so you can find it again.
goal.ur: End tak aap pandrah minute ki search routine par chalenge, PEDro, Cochrane aur PubMed mein se chunenge, AND, OR aur MeSH terms se Boolean search banayenge, aur jo mila usay mehfooz karenge taake dobara mil jaye.

text.en: Search from the **top of the pyramid down**: look for a guideline or a systematic review first, then randomised trials, and only then smaller studies. For physiotherapy, the best starting points are the **Cochrane Library** (reviews), **PEDro** (physiotherapy trials and reviews with quality scores) and **PubMed** (everything, with powerful filters). Build the search from your PICO question, not from the full sentence.
text.ur: **Pyramid ke oopar se neeche** search karein: pehle guideline ya systematic review, phir randomised trials, aur phir chhote studies. Physiotherapy ke liye behtareen aaghaz hain **Cochrane Library** (reviews), **PEDro** (physiotherapy trials aur reviews quality scores ke saath) aur **PubMed** (sab kuch, taqatwar filters ke saath). Search apne PICO sawal se banayein, poore jumle se nahi.

text.en: Think of **fishing**. A wide net catches everything, including boots and bottles. A single hook catches one fish if you are lucky. A good fisher picks the right pond, the right bait and the right size of net. Searching is the same: right database, right words, right filter.
text.ur: **Machhli pakadne** ko sochein. Bara jaal sab kuch pakadta hai, joote aur botlein bhi. Ek kanta ek machhli pakadta hai agar kismat ho. Achha machhera sahi talab, sahi chara aur sahi jaal ka size chunta hai. Search bhi aisi hai: sahi database, sahi alfaaz, sahi filter.

title.en: Where to search for physiotherapy evidence

rows.en: High-quality systematic reviews, with plain-language summaries
rows.ur: Unchi miyaar ke systematic reviews, saade zubaan ke khulase ke saath

rows.en: Not every topic has a review, and some reviews are old
rows.ur: Har mauzu par review nahi, aur kuch purane hain

rows.en: Randomised trials, reviews and guidelines in physiotherapy, with a quality score out of 10
rows.ur: Physiotherapy ke randomised trials, reviews aur guidelines, 10 mein se quality score ke saath

rows.en: The score checks method reporting, not whether the result matters to your patient
rows.ur: Score method ki report jaanchta hai, yeh nahi ke nateeja aap ke mareez ke liye ahem hai

rows.en: Everything biomedical, free, with filters and MeSH terms
rows.ur: Har biomedical cheez, muft, filters aur MeSH terms ke saath

rows.en: Millions of results if the search is too wide
rows.ur: Search wasi ho to lakhon natije

rows.en: Quick checks and finding full-text copies
rows.ur: Tez jaanch aur mukammal text ki copies dhoondhna

rows.en: No quality filters and unclear coverage; do not rely on it alone
rows.ur: Quality filters nahi aur coverage wazeh nahi; sirf isi par bharosa na karein

steps.title: Minutes 1 to 2: write the PICO and key words
steps.detail: List the main words and a few synonyms for each part, for example "low back pain" OR "lumbago". || Minute 1 se 2: PICO aur key words likhein

steps.title: Minutes 3 to 6: search for reviews and guidelines first
steps.detail: Try Cochrane and PEDro with your key words. If a recent, good review answers the question, read it. || Minute 3 se 6: pehle reviews aur guidelines dhoondhein

steps.title: Minutes 7 to 11: widen to PubMed if needed
steps.detail: Combine parts with AND, synonyms with OR, and add a filter for the study type and the last five to ten years. || Minute 7 se 11: zaroorat ho to PubMed tak wasi karein

steps.title: Minutes 12 to 14: screen titles and abstracts
steps.detail: Keep only studies that match your patient and outcome, and note their design and quality. || Minute 12 se 14: title aur abstract chhantein

steps.title: Minute 15: save it
steps.detail: Save the search, the date and the key papers, so you can update or share it. || Minute 15: mehfooz karein

question.en: You search PubMed for "knee pain exercise" and get 40,000 results. Which change would narrow it most usefully?
question.ur: Aap PubMed par "knee pain exercise" search karte hain aur 40,000 natije aate hain. Kaun si tabdeeli sab se mufeed taur par isay tang karegi?

text.en: Remove all filters and read the first page
text.ur: Saare filters hata kar pehla safha parhein

feedback.ur: Yeh bekaar mila-jula nateeja deta hai.

feedback.en: OR widens the search, not narrows it.
feedback.ur: OR search ko wasi karta hai, tang nahi.

text.en: Add specific terms with AND (for example "osteoarthritis" AND "randomized controlled trial") and limit to recent years
text.ur: AND se khaas alfaaz shamil karein (masalan "osteoarthritis" AND "randomized controlled trial") aur haal ke saalon tak mehdood karein

feedback.en: Yes — adding specific concepts with AND and a study-type filter narrows the results sensibly.
feedback.ur: Haan — AND se khaas concepts aur study-type filter se natije samajhdari se tang hote hain.

question.en: What does Boolean OR do between "back pain" and "lumbago"?
question.ur: "back pain" aur "lumbago" ke beech Boolean OR kya karta hai?

text.en: Finds papers that use either word, widening the search to include synonyms
text.ur: Woh papers dhoondta hai jo kisi ek lafz ko istemal karte hon, muradifaat shamil kar ke search wasi karta hai

feedback.en: Yes — OR joins synonyms so you do not miss papers that use another word.
feedback.ur: Haan — OR muradifaat jorta hai taake doosra lafz istemal karne wale papers na chhutein.

text.en: Finds only papers that use both words
text.ur: Sirf woh papers dhoondta hai jo dono alfaaz istemal karte hon

text.en: Excludes papers that use the second word
text.ur: Doosra lafz istemal karne wale papers nikal deta hai

question.en: A PEDro score of 8/10 for a trial means what?
question.ur: Ek trial ke liye PEDro score 8/10 ka matlab kya hai?

text.en: The trial report meets most method-quality criteria; it does not prove the result is large or important for your patient
text.ur: Trial report zyada tar method-quality criteria poore karti hai; yeh sabit nahi karta ke nateeja bara ya aap ke mareez ke liye ahem hai

feedback.en: Yes — the score reflects reported methods, not clinical importance.
feedback.ur: Haan — score report shuda methods dikhata hai, clinical ahmiyat nahi.

feedback.en: The score is not an effect size.

text.en: The study is certainly free of bias
text.ur: Study yaqeenan bias se paak hai

feedback.en: No study is certainly free of bias.
feedback.ur: Koi study yaqeenan bias se paak nahi.

text.en: **Searching with a full sentence, or stopping at the first few results.** Search engines match words, not meaning. Also, relying only on one database misses studies. Use your key words, combine with AND and OR, check a second source, and always note the date of the search so you know how current it is.
text.ur: **Poore jumle se search karna, ya pehle chand natijon par ruk jana.** Search engines alfaaz milate hain, matlab nahi. Sirf ek database par bharosa karne se studies chhoot jati hain. Apne key words istemal karein, AND aur OR se jorein, doosra zariya dekhein, aur search ki tareekh zaroor likhein taake pata rahe kitni taaza hai.

text.en: **Use the 15 minutes before a complicated patient.** Searching for "systematic review" plus your condition often gives a summary in one click. When you share what you find with the patient, say how strong it is: "A good review found that exercise helps a little, and I will tell you what it means for you."
text.ur: **Mushkil mareez se pehle pandrah minute istemal karein.** "systematic review" aur apni bimari search karne se aksar ek click mein khulasa mil jata hai. Jab mareez ko batayein to yeh bhi batayein ke kitna mazboot hai: "Ek achhe review ne paya ke exercise thora madad karti hai, aur main batata hoon is ka aap ke liye kya matlab hai."

question.en: What is MeSH, and why does it help?
question.ur: MeSH kya hai, aur kyun madad karta hai?

answer.en: MeSH (Medical Subject Headings) is PubMed's controlled vocabulary. Authors may write "lumbago", "low back pain" or "lumbar pain", but an indexer tags them all with one MeSH term. Searching the MeSH term catches all of them, so it finds papers that your own words would miss. Combine MeSH with free-text words for the best coverage.
answer.ur: MeSH (Medical Subject Headings) PubMed ki controlled vocabulary hai. Musannif "lumbago", "low back pain" ya "lumbar pain" likh sakte hain, lekin indexer sab ko ek MeSH term se tag karta hai. MeSH term search karne se sab pakde jate hain, isliye woh papers milte hain jo aap ke apne alfaaz miss kar dete. Behtareen coverage ke liye MeSH ko free-text alfaaz ke saath milayein.

beats.patient: A therapist wants to know whether dry needling helps neck pain. She types the whole question into Google and gets a mix of adverts and blogs.
beats.assessment: The question is not turned into search words, and Google has no study filters.
beats.treatment: She writes PICO, searches PEDro and Cochrane for "neck pain" and "dry needling", then PubMed with ("neck pain" OR "cervical pain") AND ("dry needling") AND (systematic review).
beats.reassess: She finds two recent reviews in 15 minutes, reads their conclusions, and saves the search to update later.

text.en: **Evidence found online is not always evidence.** Be careful with predatory journals, social media posts and adverts dressed as science. Check the journal, the authors, the date, the funding and whether other sources agree. For safety questions, such as manipulation or medicine interactions, do not rely on a single paper.
text.ur: **Online mila evidence hamesha evidence nahi hota.** Predatory journals, social media posts aur science ke libaas mein ishtiharat se khabardar rahein. Journal, musannif, tareekh, funding dekhein aur yeh ke doosre zarai mutafiq hain ya nahi. Safety ke sawalon, jaise manipulation ya dawai ke interaction, mein ek paper par bharosa na karein.

text.en: The PEDro scale rates the methodological quality of randomised trials on items such as random allocation, concealed allocation, blinding of assessors, adequate follow-up and between-group comparisons, and has been shown to have acceptable reliability when used by trained raters. The Cochrane Handbook describes how to search several databases with controlled vocabulary and free-text terms, and recommends combining sources because no single database finds everything.
text.ur: PEDro scale randomised trials ki methodological quality ko random allocation, chhupa hua allocation, assessors ki blinding, kaafi follow-up aur groups ke beech muqabla jaise items par rate karta hai, aur trained raters ke istemal par qabil-e-qubool reliability dikhata hai. Cochrane Handbook batata hai ke kai databases mein controlled vocabulary aur free-text alfaaz se kaise search karein, aur zariye milane ki sifarish karta hai kyunke koi ek database sab kuch nahi dhoondta.

text.en: **Top down, Terms, Two sources, Time-stamp.** Start at the top of the pyramid, use terms not sentences, check two sources, and record the date.
text.ur: **Top down, Terms, Two sources, Time-stamp.** Pyramid ke oopar se shuru, alfaaz na ke jumle, do zarai, aur tareekh likhein.

summary.en: Search top-down: guidelines and reviews first, then trials, using key words built from your PICO.
summary.ur: Oopar se neeche search karein: pehle guidelines aur reviews, phir trials, PICO se bane key words ke saath.

summary.en: AND narrows, OR widens, and MeSH terms catch synonyms; use PEDro and Cochrane for physiotherapy topics and PubMed for breadth.
summary.ur: AND tang karta hai, OR wasi karta hai, aur MeSH terms muradifaat pakadte hain; physiotherapy ke liye PEDro aur Cochrane, aur wusat ke liye PubMed.

summary.en: Save the search with the date, check two sources, and be careful with predatory sites and adverts.
summary.ur: Search tareekh ke saath mehfooz karein, do zarai dekhein, aur predatory sites aur ishtiharat se khabardar rahein.

back.en: Narrows the search: both terms must be present.
back.ur: Search tang karta hai: dono alfaaz hone chahiye.

back.en: Widens the search: either term is enough, good for synonyms.
back.ur: Search wasi karta hai: koi ek lafz kaafi hai, muradifaat ke liye achha.

back.en: PubMed's controlled vocabulary that groups synonyms under one term.
back.ur: PubMed ki controlled vocabulary jo muradifaat ko ek term ke neeche jama karti hai.

front.en: What does a PEDro score tell you?

back.en: How many method-quality criteria a trial report meets, not how large the effect is.
back.ur: Trial report kitne method-quality criteria poore karti hai, effect kitna bara hai yeh nahi.

note.en: Build the question before you search.
